# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
# LDAP search_s / Connection.search with dynamic filter must still fire.
lang: python
file: CWE-90-regex-search-vulnerable.py
---
import ldap
from ldap3 import Connection


def find_user_ldap3(conn: Connection, username: str):
    return conn.search("ou=people,dc=example,dc=com", f"(uid={username})")


def find_user_python_ldap(conn, username: str):
    return conn.search_s("ou=people,dc=example,dc=com", ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE, f"(uid={username})")
